purpose: Teach: 三角形/水晶/ルネサンス/ナベ/円盤/ボールペン/鳥居/フルート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで三角形をいっぱい描いてみてね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you try drawing lots of triangles for me?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Gentle forward lean. Speak as if inviting him into something special, not instructing. Slow enough for a six-year-old to follow.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんから水晶のお守りもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandma gave me a crystal amulet!
lines.style: Bright, eager burst. Small voice cracking with pride. Eyes wide. Quick, bouncing energy — the kind of child who can barely contain good news.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがルネサンス絵画の本を持ってるのよ
lines.en: That's wonderful, Sho. I have a book about Renaissance paintings — would you like to see it?
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful opening. Genuinely pleased for him. Pause after the dash — considering, generous. Inviting without pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがナベで作るおでん大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Grandpa's oden when he makes it in the pot.
lines.style: Wistful, comfortable. The voice of a child who's thinking about something he loves. Soft smile in the delivery. No urgency — just savoring the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古いレコードの円盤を集めてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Your father collects old vinyl records, doesn't he? That's rather special.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Warm recognition of how the pieces fit together. Slight lift of wonder — noticing the small inheritances between people.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き用にボールペン買ってもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad got me a ballpoint pen for drawing!
lines.style: Genuine delight, smaller and truer than the first outburst. Pride in the specific gift. Simple joy — not performed, just offered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと近所の鳥居までお散歩しましょうね
lines.en: Would you like to take a walk with me to the shrine near here?
lines.style: Soft, unhurried invitation. The voice of someone making space for him. Gentle lilt upward at the end — not demanding, but genuinely wanting his company.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからフルート習ってるよ
lines.en: I'm learning flute from Dad, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Quiet pride. The voice of a child stating something true about himself. Not boasting — just real. Small, steady confidence underneath.
